title: Custom Recipes Datapack
description: This datapack allows you to craft, smelt, and cook many different items that are not possible in Vanilla Minecraft! In short, this datapack adds tons of new recipes! Have fun!
body:
✨ Expand your Minecraft crafting possibilities! ✨

Have you ever wanted to craft items that are impossible to obtain or create in Vanilla Minecraft? This datapack changes that!

With this datapack, you can craft, smelt, and cook many (and I really mean MANY!) (I think) :) different items that normally have no recipes. It adds a huge collection of new recipes and gives you more possibilities while playing Minecraft.

From useful items to unique creations — this datapack expands the Vanilla experience and makes survival more exciting!

⚒️ Features:

Hundreds of new crafting recipes
New smelting and cooking recipes
More ways to obtain items
Fully compatible with Vanilla Minecraft
No mods required!

Have fun exploring all the new possibilities! 🎉

Well... maybe I exaggerated a bit, but there's still plenty more to come! ...
(Ok, ok it's not the best datapack! I exaggerated a bit, but whatever) Just give it a try!
